curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a trafficking case collides with the trail of the elusive Truck Stop Killer, can partnered agents corner their target before another life is taken?
curatedMovie.description: While working to bust a sex-trafficking ring, FBI agents Karl Helter and Rebecca Lombardo cross paths with a brutal serial killer, teaming up with state law enforcement to stop the infamous Truck Stop Killer.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Grim and tense crime mystery packed with procedural grit, heavy stakes, and focused solitary viewing demand.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Randall Emmett delivers a grim, suspense-charged manhunt procedural driven by high stakes and converging federal and state investigations.
